summary.content:
Today's selection covers 105 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 70 on Artificial Intelligence and 23 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: The Small-Business Owners Managing Whole Armies of A.I. Employees
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Chinese hackers use new Atlas RAT malware in European cyberattacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, The Verge, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 48 articles published in the last 24 hours
